question_text:
3.  
The capital structure of JKL Limited consists of 12% debentures of ` 50 
lakhs, 10% preference shares of ` 25 lakhs, 14% term loan of ` 15 lakhs 
and equity share capital of ` 48 lakhs. Its reserves & surpluses are ` 24 
lakhs. What would be the capital-gearing ratio? 
(A)  1.04 
(B)  
1.25 
(C)  1.33 
(D)  1.56 
 
 

 
INTERMEDIATE EXAMINATION 
 
 
78 
 
REVISION TEST PAPERS 
MAY 2026 EXAMINATION
PART - II Descriptive Questions 
Ratio Analysis
suggested_answer: (B) 1.25 Capital Gearing Ratio = Pref. Share Capital + Debentures + Other Borrowed Funds Equity Share Capital + Reserves and Surplus −Losses = ` 25 lakhs + ` 50 lakhs + ` 15 lakhs ` 48 lakhs + ` 24 lakhs = ` 90 lakhs ` 72 lakhs =1.25 4. (i) Operating Expenses Net Profit = 8% on Sales = 8% x ` 3,60,00,000 ` 28,80,000 Add: Income Tax = 40% x ` 28,80,000/60% ` 19,20,000 Profit Before tax ` 48,00,000 Add: Debenture Interest ` 3,36,000 Profit before interest and tax ` 51,36,000 Sales ` 3,60,00,000 FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT AND STRATEGIC MANAGEMENT 89 MAY 2026 EXAMINATION REVISION TEST PAPERS Less: Cost of goods sold ` 1,44,00,000 Profit before interest & tax ` 51,36,000 ` 1,95,36,000 Operating Expenses ` 1,64,64,000 (ii) Share Capital and Reserves Return on Net worth is 30%, hence profit after tax of ` 28,80,000 is equivalent to 30% of Net Worth. Net worth x 30/100 = ` 28,80,000 Net Worth = 28,80,000 x 100/30 = ` 96,00,000 Ratio of Share Capital to Reserves = 6:4 Share Capital = ` 96,00,000 x 6/10 = ` 57,60,000 Reserves =` 96,00,000 x 4/10 = ` 38,40,000 (iii) Closing Stock Inventory Turnover (based on cost of goods sold) = 12 Cost of goods sold = ` 1,44,00,000 Inventory Turnover Ratio = Cost of goods sold/Closing Stock = 12 12 = ` 1,44,00,000/Closing Stock Therefore, Closing Stock = ` 1,44,00,000/12 = ` 12,00,000 (iv) Fixed Assets Calculation of Total liabilities Interest on 14 % Debentures = ` 3,36,000 Therefore debentures = ` 3,36,000 x 100 14% = ` 24,00,000 INTERMEDIATE EXAMINATION 90 REVISION TEST PAPERS MAY 2026 EXAMINATION Total of Liabilities Side Share Capital ` 57,60,000 Reserves ` 38,40,000 Debentures ` 24,00,000 Sundry Creditors ` 16,00,000 Total Liabilities ` 1,36,00,000 Current Ratio = 2:1 Sundry Creditors = ` 16,00,000 Current Assets Current Liabilities = 2 Current Assets Sundry Creditors = 2 Current Assets ` 16,00,000 = 2 Current Assets = 2 x ` 16,00,000 = ` 32,00,000 Fixed Assets = Total Liabilities – Current Assets = ` 1,36,00,000 - ` 32,00,000 = ` 1,04,00,000 5. (i) Let the cost of Equity be ‘X’ and Cost of Debt be ‘Y’ Calculation of WACC using Book value weights Source of Capital Cost of capital Weights WACC (Ko) (a) (b) (c) = (a)×(b) Equity Share Capital X 0.5 0.5X Long term debts Y 0.5 0.5Y 11 FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT AND STRATEGIC MANAGEMENT 91 MAY 2026 EXAMINATION REVISION TEST PAPERS Calculation of WACC using market value weights Source of Capital Cost of capital MV Weights WACC (Ko) (a) (b) (c) = (a)×(b) Equity Share Capital X 3/4 = 0.75 0.75X Long term debts Y 1/4 = 0.25 0.25Y 11+1.5 = 12.5 0.5X + 0.5Y = 11 …..(1) 0.75X + 0.25Y = 12.5 …..(2) Equating 1 & 2 Ke (X) = 14% Substituting X in Eqn. 1 0.5x14 + 0.5Y = 11 7 + 0.5Y = 11 Post tax Kd (Y)= 8% (ii) Pre Tax Cost of Redeemable Debenture (Kd) = ( ) ( ) RV-NP I+ n RV+NP 2 Where, I = Interest payment NP = Net proceeds RV = Redemption value of debentures n = Remaining life of debentures kd = 7+ (100-90) 4 (100+90) 2 INTERMEDIATE EXAMINATION 92 REVISION TEST PAPERS MAY 2026 EXAMINATION kd = 7+2.5 95 Pre Tax Kd = 10% Post tax Kd = Pre tax Kd (1–T) 8% = 10%(1–T) Tax rate (T) = 20% (iii) According to CAPM Cost of Equity (Ke)= Rf + ß (Rm − Rf) Where, Ke = Cost of equity capital Rf = Risk free rate of return ß = Beta coefficient Rm = Rate of return on market portfolio (Rm – Rf) = Market risk premium 14% = 8% + ß x 6% Beta coefficient = 1 Working Note: A Ltd 15.20 = Rf + 1.2Rp ……(1) B Ltd 12.80 = Rf + 0.8Rp ……(2) By solving Eqn. 1 & 2, Rp = 6 So Risk Premium = 6% Substituting Rp = 6 in Eqn 1 15.20 = Rf + 1.2x6% Rf = 15.20 – 7.20 = 8% FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT AND STRATEGIC MANAGEMENT 93 MAY 2026 EXAMINATION REVISION TEST PAPERS Hence, Risk Free Return = 8% Rp = Rm – Rf 6 = Rm – 8% Rm = 14%
